name: Valley of Hearts
description: Sumru left the children she gave birth to at a young age and built a new life and family for herself. Melek and Nuh learn their mother's identity from their grandmother's final words and set out to find her. Sumru, who is now married to one of Cappadocia's wealthiest businessmen, Samet, continues her lavish life with the children she had with him. However, she has different plans regarding Samet's son from his first marriage, Cihan. The paths of Melek and Nuh, who are seeking to confront their mother, will unexpectedly cross with Cihan and his reluctant fiancée, Sevilay.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Sumru has left behind the twins she gave birth to years ago and started a new life and family with Samet Şansalan, one of the wealthiest people in Cappadocia. Nuh and Melek, who have grown up unaware of their mother's identity for years, are faced with this reality on their most painful day. With a rage that has accumulated over the years, they come to Cappadocia, leaving their hometown and everything behind. Samet Şansalan's eldest son from his first marriage, Cihan, comes to visit his family. Although he thinks that this will be a short visit, he finds himself in the midst of his father and aunt Hikmet’s plans. Hikmet's daughter Sevilay does not like her role in this plan one bit. The possibility of Cihan staying in Cappadocia upsets many people, including his jealous half-brother Esat. Coming to town to confront their mother, Nuh and Melek unexpectedly cross paths with Cihan and Sevilay. However, the twins will experience real surprise when they face their mother, Sumru.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Sumru is stunned when she sees Melek and Nuh in front of her. After this confrontation, the alarm bells begin to ring for Sumru. Sevilay finds herself in a difficult situation after Cihan approves of this marriage. Even though she tries to explain to her mother that she doesn't love Cihan, Hikmet, who has made plans with Samet, ignores Sevilay's objections. Cihan realizes that Sevilay doesn't want this marriage, but he refuses to go back on his promise to his father. Cihan, who is trying to keep this secret from everyone, can’t get the moment he met Melek out of his mind. Despite Sumru’s efforts to keep the twins away from her, Nuh and Melek are determined to make her pay her debt as a mother. While they are in pursuit of the motherly love they deserve, they won’t be able to remain indifferent to the love that crosses their path.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Sumru, Melek, and Nihayet find themselves trapped in the flames as a fire breaks out at the vineyard house. Nuh, driven by sheer determination, plunges into the fire. This situation leaves Nuh torn between his desire for revenge and his capacity for mercy. Melek and Nuh, facing the threat of losing each other, are tested by great fear. As the twins grow even closer, this trial brings them one step closer to their goals. Cihan is in a dilemma, unable to stay away from Melek. Though he wants to follow his heart, he can't escape the obligations his father has imposed on him. For Sevilay, who is aware of her feelings for Nuh, the decision to marry Cihan becomes even more difficult. While Sevilay accepts her fate, she will fall victim to the schemes being plotted against her. Sumru realizes that she can no longer keep the twins away from her life and family. Her nerves frayed, she must confront the fear of her life falling apart.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sumru, who cannot cope alone with the burden of the secret about the twins, finally tells her mother the truth. She is taken aback by what she hears. The time that Nuh and Melek have given Sumru is running out. Although Melek is more cautious than Nuh, Nuh is determined. No matter the outcome, he does not want to turn back from his path. Cihan, whose feelings towards Melek are intensifying, finds himself in a deadlock. On the one hand, he is searching for a way out of the situation he has fallen into, while on the other hand, he seeks ways to express himself to Melek. Harika's surprise shocks everyone. Harika's move pushes Sevilay to take new steps. The henna night is a turning point for the Sansalan family and the people who have entered their lives. This explosion will ignite the fuse for even bigger events to come.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Melek and Nuh cannot hide their astonishment when they finally see Nihayet. Sumru is watching what will happen from afar. With Sevilay's acceptance of marrying Cihan for Hikmet, the wedding preparations begin in the mansion. Cihan, who is trying to save his family from the difficult situation they are in, searches for different ways. However, the only thing he encounters is his father's insistence. Sevilay, who does not want to marry Cihan, is in a tough spot. Nevertheless, while trying to stand by her feelings, she will also lay the foundation for new friendships. Although the twins appear strong against the situations they find themselves in, their longing for love will lead them to many more disappointments.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While Sevilay's "no" at the wedding table shocks everyone, Hikmet goes mad with anger. Sevilay's decision makes Melek and Cihan happy. Nuh cannot hide his joy in this unexpected situation. Now that there are no obstacles left for the lovers, everyone takes steps towards their feelings without hesitation. Cihan and Sevilay's feelings for the twins are now clearly noticed by Samet and Hikmet. This puts Sumru in a deeper dilemma. Fearing that her secret will be revealed, Sumru is still under the threat of Melek and Nuh. While the Sansalan family tries to overcome the crises they face, they find themselves in the midst of an unexpected danger. This danger comes from those closest to them.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Nuh and Melek are disappointed once again when they see Sevilay and Cihan getting married. This situation reminds them again that they have no one but each other. While Cihan is looking for a chance to explain himself to Melek, Sevilay is threatened by Hikmet. Even though Nuh tries to understand Sevilay, what he will hear will cause him pain. Samet is determined to keep the twins away from the mansion. Sumru, who is cornered, tries to prevent this situation. Because Melek and Nuh, who will face the Şansalans, may reveal Sumru's secret at any moment. Even though Sumru tries to prevent this, the situations she cannot prevent will put both her and Melek and Nuh in a dead end.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: With the truth that Hikmet learns, she gains a significant advantage. She has the opportunity to send Sumru and Nihayet out of the house and take control of the mansion. After what Cihan and Melek have experienced, they can no longer stay apart. Unable to stay away from Melek, Cihan makes firm decisions. These decisions disturb those around him. Sevilay is forced to stay away from Nuh due to threats from her mother. Unable to accept the situation, Nuh is devastated by what Sevilay says. However, both of them struggle to silence their hearts. Sumru's attitude towards the twins has started to change. Nihayet is uncomfortable with this change. Sumru, who is on edge, is unaware of the looming danger. No one at the Şansalan mansion will be able to return to their old lives.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The big secret revealed by Hikmet creates an explosive effect at the Şansalan mansion. This secret also leads to the reopening of old issues. The shock experienced changes the dynamics between Melek, Cihan, Nuh, and Sevilay. As the truths change for everyone, seeds of discord begin to be sown slowly. Sumru will be surprised by the helping hand extended to her while being disappointed by her loved ones in her difficult time.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The news of Melek and Nuh's escape quickly reaches the mansion. Cihan becomes convinced that there is someone powerful behind them. Tahsin, taking the twins with him, provides them with protection. After everything that has happened, it will be the first time that Melek and Nuh's opinions will be so opposite. Sevilay and Cihan struggle to cope with the pain of betrayal. However, their trust will be shattered once more by the secrets they are about to learn. Despite Nihayet, Sumru decides to stand on her own feet. However, no matter how hard she tries, Samet's moves always hinder her.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Sevilay, bewildered by what Nihayet said, will face a major confrontation with the Şansalan family individually. The twins, who have taken refuge with Tahsin, cannot come to terms with what they have experienced. While they need to cling to each other, the bond between them will face a great test. Cihan, who has not yet overcome the pain of betrayal, learns that he has been deceived by his father this time. Due to what he has gone through, he can no longer tolerate defeat. Sumru, who is trying to stand on her own feet again, is struggling. On one hand, Nihayet's demands, and on the other, her longing for her children will push her to the brink of new decisions.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Cihan and Nuh have drawn their guns on each other. Although Sevilay wants to stay by Nuh’s side, she fears that Cihan’s armed men surrounding them might harm Nuh under his orders. Nuh, however, refuses to back down, no matter what. The tension strains the previously understanding relationship between Sevilay and Cihan. While Cihan tries to suppress his feelings for Melek, his anger begins to consume those around him. Melek, on the other hand, stands on the brink of a difficult decision. Overwhelmed by the disappointment and heartbreak caused by Cihan, she contemplates terminating the pregnancy. Meanwhile, Sumru is determined to make amends for her past mistakes. As she strives to stand on her own two feet, she also tries to fulfill her responsibilities as a mother to the twins. However, even as the truth comes to light, greater challenges await everyone.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: When Melek sees Cihan lying on the ground covered in blood, she realizes she is on an irreversible path. The Şansalan family is taken aback by Cihan’s shooting. Despite Cihan's attitude towards her and those around him, Sevilay becomes devastated. While Nuh is unaware of everything, Tahsin is by Melek's side. Although Melek is heartbroken thinking the road has ended, Tahsin will not leave her alone. As the Şansalan family is in turmoil due to Cihan's condition, Sumru once again confronts them. Unable to bear the words she hears from her own children, Sumru will realize once more that she is alone in her new life.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: According to Cihan's statement, the Şansalan family is pleased; Sumru, Nuh, and Tahsin are devastated. Despite their love, Melek and Cihan continue to deeply wound each other. Cihan's anger towards Melek does not subside, while Melek's disappointment in Cihan grows. Nuh does not leave his sister alone but is filled with a desire for revenge against Cihan. Sevilay tries to turn Cihan away from his mistakes. However, both Cihan's love and anger will be tested by the truths he will learn. Sumru being with Tahsin and the twins discomforts the Şansalan family. Sumru does not bow to the Şansalan family, but other dangers she faces will cause old wounds to be remembered.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Sumru, on the verge of reliving a nightmare from her past, tries every possible way to escape. Help for Sumru, who is at a dead end, comes from unexpected people. Nuh confronts Sumru. In this confrontation, the longing for his mother that has built up over the years causes him a great emotional outburst. Melek is released after Cihan changes his statement. But this is not enough to mend their relationship. On the contrary, everything will become even more difficult. The captivity she experiences pushes Sevilay to her limits. Her conversation with Cihan makes her even more hopeless. But thanks to her surprise ally, she finds the courage she was looking for. While the opposing side strengthens in this ongoing battle for the fortunate ones, internal cracks begin to emerge.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Cihan leaves everything behind and confronts Melek to ask for forgiveness. Although Melek is still in love with Cihan, she cannot trust him because of what they've been through. While Sevilay and Nuh are happy to be reunited, they aim to remove the biggest obstacle standing in their way. Sumru, who is happy to be with Nuh and Melek, also experiences a development in her life. Although this situation is not a surprise for Sumru, it will affect both her and her twins' lives. Unexpected collaborations in Şansalanlar lead to great chaos. As a result, the still-unopened secrets of the past will come to light.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Hikmet and Esat's plan drives Sevilay and Melek to the edge of a cliff. When Hikmet realizes at the last moment that Sevilay is also in the car, she tries to save them. The situation with Sevilay and Melek once again brings Nuh and Cihan face to face. Even though Cihan regrets his actions and tries to make things right, everyone, including his own family, is now against him. After hearing Tahsin's feelings, Sumru decides to turn a new page and learns that Gürcan's wife is going to sell her shop. Just when she thinks everything will get better, these developments present new challenges for Sumru.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Cihan decides to return to Germany after an argument with his family. Melek, after reading Cihan's letter, decides to leave everything behind and goes to the airport to follow her love. However, it will be difficult to stop Cihan at the last moment. Sevilay supports Nuh and Melek. Nuh, on the other hand, clearly sets boundaries to prevent the Şansalan family from causing them more harm. The divorce hearing for Sumru and Samet takes place. Although Sumru is happy to start a new life, Samet is determined not to give her peace. While everyone thinks all the secrets have been revealed, what happens will open the pages of the past once more. Great changes await both the Şansalan family and the people in their lives.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Samet is unaware that Nihayet overhears him as he reveals his big secret to the doctor. Cihan, who returns to Cappadocia for his father, encounters Melek. Although Cihan cannot openly confess his love for Melek to her face, Melek once again understands his feelings. Meanwhile, Sevilay and Nuh are waiting for the day when Sevilay will officially be free. Sumru, having completely left her old life behind, is now happy with her children and Tahsin. She believes that one day Esat and Harika will also be by her side. While the Şansalan family has come together for Samet, a big surprise awaits them.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Finally, the big secret is revealed. Everyone learns that Bünyamin is Samet's son. While Bünyamin feels faint upon hearing this, Samet's only concern is not losing his potential donor. With his father's illness and the newly uncovered truth, Cihan once again tries to solve family issues. Melek feels sorry for him. It will become impossible for them to hide their feelings from each other. Sevilay, having divorced Cihan, is now free. Nuh plans to propose to her. They both want to be happy together, but new problems will arise. Sumru gets the chance to confront Samet. Although she is surprised she didn't see the truth all these years, she will now stand on her own feet and be by her children's side.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Tahsin stands against Samet and the others to buy the mansion. However, due to another major incident, he is forced to postpone his goal. While Melek and Cihan worry about their baby, they soon learn that everything is fine. They want to finally embrace their love with happiness, but having to keep their relationship a secret from Nuh makes things increasingly difficult. Nuh does not want the Şansalan family around, especially Cihan. His anger creates tension between him and Sevilay, prompting him to try to restrain himself. Just as Sumru thinks everything is going well, she once again finds herself consumed by concerns for her children. Meanwhile, the Şansalan family will face new obligations.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Just as everyone has accepted peace, Nuh is left in shock by an unexpected phone call. Sumru and the twins grow increasingly worried when they realize Tahsin is nowhere to be found. Nuh and Sumru suspect that the Şansalan family is behind this. Meanwhile, just as Melek and Cihan are about to put everything in order, they are hit with unexpected and unpleasant surprises. The path to a peaceful and harmonious relationship becomes even more challenging for them. Nuh’s hatred toward the Şansalan family continues to grow, leading to sudden outbursts against those around him. Sevilay, on the other hand, struggles to endure the situation any longer. Concerned for Tahsin, Sumru is forced to confront the depth of her feelings for him. She realizes she cannot bear the thought of losing the one man in her life who truly loves and values her.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The police search Tahsin's garden upon receiving a tip, which puts Tahsin and Sumru in great danger. They both think everything is ruined. Cihan proposes to Melek. While the couple in love are together against all odds, they are aware that the biggest obstacle in front of them is Nuh. Nuh's hatred of Şansalan worries his family. While his reactions start to scare Sevilay, the tension between the two becomes tense, and they enter a path of no return. While Samet's illness deals a great blow to the Şansalans, they are faced with a bad surprise. Now the tide will turn for Sumru and the Şansalans.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Sumru's life is in danger as a result of the accident she made. Witnessing the accident, Hikmet leaves Sumru to her fate. Cihan demands that Melek make a decision now. The situation becomes increasingly difficult for Melek, who is torn between her twin Nuh and her great love Cihan. Sevilay is not at all happy to have made a clear decision and returned to the Şansalans because of Nuh's anger. Nuh, on the other hand, does not accept that he has lost Sevilay and does everything he can to reach her. Nuh's anger towards the Şansalans pushes him to irreversible moves. As a result of these moves, he will be face to face with all his loved ones, especially Melek.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Nuh and Hikmet are both detained upon complaints. Despite everything, they continue to deal with each other. Cihan explains his decision to Melek by not accepting any obstacle. He wants to be happy with Melek and their baby to be born without seeing Nuh or anyone else as an excuse. Noah pays for his anger by alienating his loved ones from him. As long as he does not change, both his family and Sevilay's attitude towards him is clear. Sumru, as upset as she is, realizes that Noah needs to rub her nose in order to change. The information she will learn will upset the balance in both families.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked when the police arrest Cihan for the attempted murder of Tahsin. Although Nuh shouts that he was right, Melek does not want to believe this accusation. While Tahsin pursues the truth, Sumru tries to restrain Nuh. She realizes that she must take a stand against Noah to stop him. Sevilay cannot hide the sadness of being disappointed over and over again. Noah, on the other hand, takes a big step in order not to lose his loved ones. As the ties between the two families are strained again, Hikmet finds himself a surprise ally and calls Halil, the father of the twins, to Cappadocia. While this alliance will turn the balance upside down, big confrontations await Sumru, Melek and Nuh.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: When Halil takes a big step and confronts Melek, she is surprised. Even though his father seems to be lenient towards him, Melek will ask him to account for the difficulties they had in the past and for what he did to her mother. Cihan tries to live in peace with Melek, but the responsibilities of his family haunt him. An unexpected big move will infuriate Cihan. Sumru, unaware of Halil's arrival, dreams of a big family with Tahsin and his children. Nuh and Melek are afraid that Halil's arrival will turn everything upside down. Their dilemma will lead them to great confrontations.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The twins have brought Sumru face-to-face with her worst nightmare: Halil. This confrontation will be even heavier than expected for Sumru, and Halil's revelations will leave her stunned. Hikmet's conditions for withdrawing from guardianship put Cihan and Tahsin in a difficult position. However, this move is actually part of Hikmet's bigger plan. Offended by Harika's words, Sevilay takes a major step for herself - one that will lead her into new events. Halil doesn't stop at confronting Sumru; he continues to sow seeds of doubt among her loved ones. Major trials await Sumru as she is once again forced to confront her past.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Sumru feels deeply disappointed when she realizes that neither Tahsin nor Nuh believes her, and she leaves the mansion. Tahsin does everything he can to find her and blames himself for doubting her. Nuh hides the fact that he fainted from everyone but quietly begins to investigate the matter. His growing suspicions about his mother lead to a confrontation with Melek. While Melek searches for her mother, she also tries to support Cihan, who is grieving the loss of his father. Tensions rise between her and Nuh, but at the same time, the foundation for new emotional bonds begins to form for Melek. Sevilay is happy to be getting to know her older brother. However, just as she thinks she's charting a new path for herself, unpleasant surprises start to follow her. Hurt by everything, Sumru tries to build a new life. Even the major incidents at the Sansalan household can't derail her from her chosen path.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Nuh and Sevilay are horrified by the unfortunate incident they've experienced. While Sevilay loses control, Nuh is determined not to let any harm come to her - even if it means throwing himself into the fire. As Melek and Cihan count down the days to meet their baby, the sorrow within their families continues to follow them. While Melek feels for her mother, she is also deeply worried about Sevilay. When Sumru comes face-to-face with Tahsin, she expresses all her pain and resentment. Despite Tahsin's apologies and claims of regret, Sumru remains firm and unmoved. Amid ongoing tensions within the family, long-hidden truths suddenly come to light - and their revelation will change the course of everything.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: The whole family realizes how unfair they have been to Sumru and follows her to Konya to apologize. As Sumru shouts her disappointment and resentment towards them, everyone realizes how right she is. Sevilay gets scared when she learns that Noah has a mass in his brain. As much as what she hears from the doctor upsets Sevilay, she will stand by Noah and fight with him no matter what. Noah, on the other hand, wants to focus on solving other problems in his life. Melek is upset about Sumru on the one hand and worried about Cihan's friend from Germany on the other. Although this situation causes confusion, Melek will not compromise with anyone. Finally, she is devastated for what her daughter has been through. She will no longer allow anyone to harm Sumru and will take an irreversible path if necessary.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Sumru can't stand Halil's slander and fires the gun Nihayet brought her. Sumru immediately decides to go to the police station and surrender. The family, aware of Sumru and Nihayet's situation, immediately takes action. But Sumru's resentment towards her children and Tahsin continues. Melek is disturbed by Peri's arrival in Cappadocia and tries to understand her real intentions. Peri, on the other hand, looks for ways to be close to Cihan. Sevilay worries about Noah on one hand and tries to hide her sadness and stand up for him on the other. Noah's time is getting tighter and tighter.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: While Noah, who takes all the risks, is in surgery, the hours do not pass for his loved ones. Everyone tries to support Sevilay and Melek. While the cooperation between Halil and Hikmet continues, Canan and Bünyamin are also after Halil. Despite the cold winds blowing between them, Canan and Bünyamin try not to show the situation to Tahsin. Peri tries every way to get close to Cihan. She does not stop making sly plans to achieve her goal.  Sumru, finally reunited with all her children, faces the fear of losing her son. Nuh, on the other hand, will show his love to his family even as he struggles to survive.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Hearing about what happened between Peri and Cihan upsets Melek, and Cihan tries to explain the situation to her. However, Melek, who is disappointed in Cihan, does not want to listen to him. Peri is happy with what she has done, but her actions will not go unpunished. Nuh and Sevilay overcome all obstacles and finally find happiness. After saying goodbye to their family, they go on their honeymoon. Hikmet, who has lost everything, continues to threaten Esat. Samet becomes hopeful when he hears that Şansalan's inheritance will be revealed, but he too will be met with an unexpected surprise like everyone else. Sumru wants to be happy with her children and Tahsin after overcoming all the difficulties. But a major test awaits Sumru on this path to happiness.
